description: Stop the endless WebSocket reconnect flood: retries are now bounded (5 attempts with 3s-24s backoff, then quiet park on HTTP/SSE fallback with a background probe every 60s). A small tap-to-retry status pill replaces the console spam, and double-counted failures (onerror+onclose for one drop) are fixed.
features: Bounded WS reconnect: 5 attempts with exponential backoff, then quiet park on HTTP/SSE fallback.
Tap-to-retry status pill instead of endless console errors; vanishes when WS recovers.
Fixed double-counted failures and uncapped constructor-throw retry path.
Version synced to 0.17.5 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
